sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Launch a Claude Code session bound to one brain with a scoped token. Brain:
sessions.launchHint: Start a Claude Code session bound to
sessions.readHint: Read-only: the agent can recall from this brain but not retain into it.
sessions.writeHint: Read and write: the agent can recall from and retain into this brain.
sessions.tokenOnce: This token is shown once. Copy it now.
sessions.step1: Copy the config above into .mcp.json at the root of your project.
sessions.step2: Start Claude Code in that folder and approve the Zekra MCP server.
sessions.step3: Ask it to recall from the brain. With writes on, it can retain new memories too.
